personal.bio: I'm a Senior Software Engineer with 8 years of experience designing and building robust web applications, distributed systems, and high-performance REST APIs. I've worked across the full stack — from crafting intuitive React frontends to architecting resilient backend services with Java and Node.js. Currently at Autodesk, I contribute to large-scale platform engineering, having led a team of 5 and driven initiatives around service regionalization. I'm passionate about clean architecture, developer tooling, and shipping products that scale.

highlights: Led a team of 5 engineers on platform initiatives
Drove service regionalization for improved availability and compliance across regions
Contributed to Fusion 360 desktop and web platform engineering
Worked as an individual contributor on distributed backend systems
Built and maintained scalable REST APIs
Worked on TaxCPC portal in tax assessment project
